metadata.description: Brett Callaghan's Claude Code plugins: specs (spec-first authoring, grooming and retrospectives) and swarm (autonomous sprint orchestration over a bead backlog)

plugins.name: specs
plugins.description: Spec-first development: authoring specs in Gherkin and EARS (ADRs, FRDs, requirements documents, architecture and feature blueprints, contracts), grooming approved feature blueprints into executable implementation plans, and retrospectives that turn friction into filed work

plugins.name: swarm
plugins.description: Autonomous sprint orchestration over a bead backlog: scope, groom, partition, dispatch into isolated worktrees, review and retro. Depends on the specs plugin, whose groom-beads skill is what brings a bead to Ready
